content_sections.heading: DSH Kadapa Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DSH Kadapa Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DSH Kadapa Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DSH Kadapa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the DSH Kadapa Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 10 August 2026. Candidates are advised to attend the interview on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PG Degree / DNB / Diploma in the particular specialty or its equivalent qualification included in the schedule - I & II of the MCI Act, 1956, and be registered with the A.P. Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DSH Kadapa Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/BC/EWS, Persons with benchmark disability, and Ex-servicemen as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 110000 Per Month for the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist posts in the Directorate of Secondary Health Kadapa.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for DSH Kadapa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit, considering qualifying degree marks (75 marks), weightage for years since passing (10 marks), and contract service weightage (15 marks), followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for DSH Kadapa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the DSH Kadapa office in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh. Specific venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).
